empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Create your first account to begin tracking balances and cards.

wipe.title: Wipe account from the system?
wipe.warning: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" from Kippa: its balance history, every transaction, its cards and their statements. This cannot be undone.
wipe.recurring: Recurring rules that will be cancelled: {{rules}}
wipe.blockingLoan: Cannot wipe: the active loan "{{name}}" is funded from this account. Re-point the loan first.

cardRemove.title: Remove "{{name}}"?
cardRemove.debit: The card disappears from this account. Its account and transactions stay.
cardRemove.credit: Removing a credit card also wipes its hidden debt account with all charges and payments. This cannot be undone.
